limitations.text: Inventory not completed: no training examples, no imagery source access, zero-shot not configured, only synthetic 160 m fixture index built. Entire AOI (~71 km2) unreviewed; no count given. Expect only partial transfer; 10 m embeddings confuse warehouses with factories/markets and need aerial verification.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in the AOI for 2024, as points with evidence, count range, and transfer note.
known_limits: Sentinel-2 10 m cannot separate warehouses from factories well; embedding cells coarse; budget limits.
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x7.8 km. Use embeddings to shortlist, verify with GSI aerial imagery and Sentinel-2. No new labels; use permitted few-shot examples from training split.
